packageRules.description: Everything that never reaches the release: dev-dependencies, the docs site, GitHub Actions, mise tools and hk with its pkl schema (one version in two files, so one PR keeps them from landing half-applied). One weekly PR typed chore, which the release tool ignores, so merging it cuts no release.

Cargo dependencies are linked into the released binary, so a bump only reaches users through a release: build is in release_commits. Own weekly PR, so a tooling bump never rides along and a runtime bump never gets typed chore. Needed because :semanticPrefixFixDepsChoreOthers types lockfile-only updates as chore, and a patch-level security fix arrives lockfile-only.

customManagers.description: hk's pkl schema is pinned by URL inside hk.pkl and no manager parses it. It has to move with the hk binary in mise.toml: hk 2.0.0 cannot evaluate a 1.x schema, and every hook dies with "listing index amendment requires an Int index". The amends/import keyword stays inside the match so each replaceString occurs once in the file; autoReplaceGlobalMatch then fixes both versions on the line.
